premises.text: Restaurants charge the same price in peak and empty periods, leaving perishable table inventory underutilized and driving waste and high failure rates
premises.evidence_span: you end up paying the exact same price for your meal at both those occasions. Well, this doesn't make economic sense, at least not for a perishable inventory

premises.text: ResGuru automatically changes restaurant prices based on demand and supply using multi-variable forecasting
premises.evidence_span: a dynamic pricing platform for restaurants. It allows the restaurants to automatically change their prices based on demand and supply

premises.text: A GDS-style console consolidates reservations and POS across channels with analytics on utilization and RevPASH
premises.evidence_span: a consolidated snapshot of my reservation diary, which is seamlessly integrated with my point of sale system

premises.text: Operators set goals, overbooking, blackouts, walk-in holds, and channel commissions to drive pricing recommendations
premises.evidence_span: I can select different overall goals. Do I want to increase my overall sales? Or do I want to increase my rev bash

premises.text: Private beta launch targets restaurant owners after pilots showing higher utilization, RevPASH, and gross profit
premises.evidence_span: We are launching our private beta today

value.text: Restaurants optimize revenue and utilization while diners can get better deals
value.evidence_span: help them optimize their revenue, but also get you better deals in your restaurants

secondary_value.text: Reduce food waste through better forecasting and pricing
secondary_value.evidence_span: 130 million pounds of food is wasted on a daily basis

causal_links.evidence_span: about 40% of the restaurant inventory is underutilized due to lack of revenue or yield management
